ti.title: ኣነስ ብምግባረይ
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
እቲ ናይ ሓዊ ባሕሪ
ብዓይነይ ከይርእዮ
ንቅዱስ ሚካኤል
ኣሕልፎ በልዮ (2)
[[/chorus]]

ኣነስ ብምግባረይ ድኹም ኮይነ’የ (2)
ሕዘንለይ ድንግል ናባኺ መጺኤ (2)

ናይ ዳዊት መሰንቆ
ናይ ኤልያስ መና
ናይ ናሆም መድኃኒት
ንዒ በደመና (2)

እነብዕ ኣለኹ
ኣብ ቅድሜኺ ኮይነ
እልምነኪ ድንግል
በደለይ ኣሚነ (2)

ti_ro.title: Anes bmgbarey
ti_ro.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
Hzenley dngl nabakhi metsie (2)
[[/chorus]]

Anes bmgbarey dkhum koyne’ye (2)
Ti nay hawi bahri
Bayney keyryo
Nqdus mikael
Ahlfo belyo (2)
Nay dawit mesenqo
Nay elyas mena
Nay nahom medhanit
Ni bedemena (2)
Kdekhmeni kelo
Nskhi’khi hayley
Nay lbey medhanit
Redait mrkusey(2)
Neb alekhu
Ab qdmekhi koyne
Lmneki dngl
Bedeley amine (2)
Zeywda mhret
Ab wedkhi alo
Neti zamneki
Selamki habyo (2)
